data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #1 - implicit_assumption): Pin ORDERING of the new re-dispatch section. The dispatch MUST be inserted BETWEEN existing Step 3 and Step 4, OR Step 4's artifact write must be moved before the re-dispatch. The artifact MUST exist on disk before re-dispatch builds remediation_context with absolute paths (a7c0's pre-generation Read gate will fail on dangling path). Add Verify: grep -n 'ARTIFACT_PATH\|Step 4' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/prompts/phase-e-adversarial-review.md should show artifact-write line precedes the dispatch block.
